recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast close-up portrait of a man wearing a distressed denim cap and dark aviator sunglasses, framed by a thick black border with bold, two-tone typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The brim of the cap creates a strong horizontal shadow across the bridge of the nose.
The reflective lenses of the sunglasses act as the central focal point, obscuring the eyes.
The thick black outer frame constrains the bright, high-key background of the inner portrait.
The typography is anchored to the top left, spanning the width of the inner image.
coreInvariants: Distressed denim texture with visible orange stitching
High-contrast lighting emphasizing facial hair texture
Black outer border containing all elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered horizontally, filling the majority of the inner frame from chest to crown.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bridge of the sunglasses and the tip of the nose.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold text at the top, moves down to the dark sunglasses, then follows the texture of the beard to the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-key white space surrounding the head within the inner frame, contrasted by the solid black outer border.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white background and black frame; low saturation except for the targeted red accent.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Italicization applied only to the secondary word for emphasis

composition.position: Top left of the inner frame
composition.relationshipToImage: Placed within the top margin of the inner photo area

treatment.fill: White for primary, Red for secondary

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family using weight and style (upright vs. italic) and color to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, American industrial feel of the layout.
Provides the necessary weight and clean geometric lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast, centered close-up portrait of a man with a beard, wearing a dark denim trucker hat with orange stitching and dark aviator sunglasses. The background is bright white. The entire image is surrounded by a thick solid black border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top left corner of the white area. The first two words should be white; the third word should be deep red and italicized.

verificationChecks: Is the text split into white and red sections?
Is the outer black border thick and uniform?
Are the eyes completely obscured by the sunglasses?

adjustableVariables: Accent color for the second text element
Width of the outer black frame
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Any brand logos on the hat or glasses
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on facial hair and denim texture

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text is italicized.
Ensure the stitching on the hat is a contrasting orange/gold.
Verify the black border does not overlap the subject's head.
Confirm the sunglasses have a dark, reflective finish.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast centered portrait + apply a thick black frame + place bold two-tone sans-serif type at the top margin.
